note: Run with --env DESK_PASSWORD=hunter2 (a test value, tests/test_websec.py's own): the optional password of app/core/websec.py, every path but /status behind HTTP Basic. The D2 cases are Python's own behaviour reproduced (DECISIONS-RS R8.10.1): a non-ASCII credential reaches hmac.compare_digest as a non-ASCII str, which raises TypeError, and Starlette answers its plain 500. Every case leaves the replay Kite's order/GTT log empty.
